title: Track Restaurant Recipe Sizes in Zoho Books #Shorts
description:
Struggling to track recipe costs for different menu sizes in Zoho Books? Learn how to use Composite Items as Bills of Materials for each size variant to automate raw ingredient deduction.

1. Go to Items › Composite Items
2. Create separate items for Pizza-S, Pizza-M, Pizza-L
3. Assign a unique Bill of Materials (BoM) to each variant

Daily Zoho fixes - follow @GSXAutomation

Question that inspired this: https://www.reddit.com/r/Zoho/comments/1wwnw5z/zoho_restaurant_posbooks/

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.
Independent channel. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Zoho Corporation. Zoho is a trademark of Zoho Corporation.

angle.problem: Tracking restaurant inventory recipes with multiple variants is complex.
angle.solution: Use 'Composite Items' with specific 'Bill of Materials' for every variant.
steps: Create separate items for Pizza-S, Pizza-M, Pizza-L
Assign a unique Bill of Materials (BoM) to each variant
angle.result: Accurate raw material consumption tracking for every menu size.
angle.hook: Struggling to track recipe costs for different menu sizes?

story.title: ZOHO Restaurant POS/books
story.summary: Hi. We run a restaurant, using petpooja for billing and zoho for accounting. Now, that zoho has launched zoho pos for restaurant with zomato integration, so I was exploring the features. We need to create BoM for tracking recipe, so i need to create composite items in zoho. But, i can't make "composite items" as variants of an item, say pizza. If my pizza has 3 size, S,M,L then I need to have recipe of all 3. Group+subgroup is possible, bit zomato does needs variants to show them properly on app. I need 5 levels of choices Pizza or beverage or dessert? Veg or Non veg Which pizza, farmhouse or pepperoni Small medium or large Would you like extra cheese or beverage? Help me configure this menu. submitted by /u/inbox4harsh [link] [comments]

lines.say: Standard items in Zoho Books might not track raw ingredients for multiple pizza variants properly.

lines.say: Fix this natively by building Composite Items with individual Bills of Materials.

screen.heading: Composite Items

lines.say: Open Zoho Books, click Items on the left panel, then select Composite Items to begin setting up your menu.
lines.tts: Open Zoho Books, click Items on the left panel, then select Composite Items to begin setting up your menu.

lines.say: Click the New button in the top right corner to create a dedicated item specifically for your small pizza.

lines.say: Under Associated Items, carefully add the exact raw ingredient quantities required for that specific size variant.

lines.say: Click Save at the bottom so your raw material inventory auto-deducts correctly every time an order is sold.

lines.say: Set this up once and your restaurant ingredient tracking is fully automated across all menu sizes seamlessly.
